MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

5. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 9

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

9. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 100

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

14. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 2

15. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

17. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

18. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 15

19. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 16

20. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

21. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 77

23. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

24. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³
